create_PddlDomain_from_yaml: create a PddlDomain instance by parsing a YAML domain file path to load actions, predicates, and constants
create_PddlProblem_with_solution: create a PddlProblem instance from domain and problem YAML files to parse objects, goals, and optional solutions
get_possible_actions: get all applicable PddlAction instances filtered by entity constraints and allowed or restricted action names
bind_to_instance: bind a PddlDomain to a RearrangeSim simulator instance to enable predicate truth evaluation against the simulation state
expand_quantifiers: expand a LogicalExpr with FORALL or EXISTS quantifiers into quantifier-free AND or OR expressions over all matching entities
